metadata.description: Cloud browsers for AI agents. Install Anchor to start. Install Anchor (all) only instead of Anchor. Anchor Actions needs a site domain.

plugins.name: anchor
plugins.description: Cloud browsers for agents: web tasks that get past bot detection, verified site actions, managed logins with MFA, and browser sessions. No concurrency limits.

plugins.name: anchor-all
plugins.description: Every Anchor REST capability as its own typed tool. Install this instead of Anchor when the client can hold a large tool list.

plugins.name: anchor-browser
plugins.description: Step-by-step control of a live Anchor browser: navigate, snapshot, click, type, screenshot, and Playwright code generation.

plugins.name: anchor-actions
plugins.description: Verified deterministic actions for one site. Set the site domain when you install.
